commit.merge_subject: merge: gles probe fixes and export stage timing

description:
Instrument the MP4 export path with per-frame stage timing, one summary
line per export, zero behavioral change (owner request 2026-11-13,
deliverable D-part-0).

New ExportStageTiming (pure Kotlin, JVM-tested): a per-export
accumulator with 7 stage slots. The pipeline times its separable stages
per video frame - native (the whole renderFrame JNI call), rotate
(RotationState.rotateRgb888), crop (CropState.applyToRgb), yuv
(YuvConverter.toI420) - and the writer reports its internals through
the new default attachTiming(timing) method on Mp4MediaWriter:
enc_wait (dequeueInputBuffer), plane_copy (getInputImage +
copyI420ToImage + imageInputSize + queueInputBuffer), drain_mux (the
per-frame drain). Default method = the JVM fakes compile untouched.

Boundary honesty: the native stage is ONE JNI call covering decode +
temporal NR + 24-stage developCpu + gyro warp + OETF + RGB888 pack;
